title: macOS Microphone Permission Flow
requirements: Add a 5-second timeout to AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for:) wrapped in withCheckedThrowingContinuation; on timeout, resume throwing a typed RecorderError.permissionTimeout — the continuation must never hang

When AVCaptureDevice.authorizationStatus(for: AVMediaType.audio) is .denied on macOS, throw RecorderError.permissionDenied and render user-facing recovery guidance to open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone

When status is .notDetermined on macOS, still attempt requestAccess(for:) but treat it as best-effort; if no callback fires within the timeout, return permissionDenied with recovery guidance rather than hanging

Provide an Open System Settings affordance (visible Button) in the recording sheet that opens the System Settings → Microphone panel via NSWorkspace.shared.open — guards the URL with a safe unwrap, no force-unwrap
Surface permission errors in the recording UI (a label or banner) rather than a silent hang
acceptance_criteria: A first-launch attempt to record either prompts correctly, fails fast within 5 seconds, or guides the user to Settings within 5 seconds
swift test --sanitize=thread passes — no race warnings on AuthorizationManager
RecorderError.permissionTimeout and RecorderError.permissionDenied both conform to LocalizedError with distinct errorDescription values
out_of_scope: Runtime re-prompt after .denied (system requires manual user action in Settings)
